text: Recorded at #967's merge, which finished #963's build by hand. A receipt page leads with its final model's own outcome. A comparison that can't be drawn gets a section of its own with its complete evidence folded beneath; beside a drawable final chart, its reason stays the card's text and the evidence is folded once. A comparison sentence names each limited side before any combined overflow, and says whose view the combined measure checked; a receipt that stores its comparison by reference gives the comparison's own reasons first, and the storage overflow only when the comparison has none.
